title: Public Alert No. 016/2026 – Alert on Confirmed Counterfeit of Mabthera 500mg/ 50ml in Nigeria

products.manufacturer: Stated on pack as Genentech Inc., Hillsboro, ABD (genuine product made for F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd, Basel, Switzerland by Roche Diagnostics GmbH, Galenical Plant, Mannheim, Germany)

summary: NAFDAC confirms counterfeit Mabthera (rituximab) 500mg/50ml, batch N2110A09, circulating in Kaduna and Gombe states. Packaging shows wrong language, bad Braille placement, fake tamper labels and a batch number absent from Roche's database. Sold cheaply; risk of treatment failure
